notes.title: Armed and Gelatinous: Couch Edition Release Date Announcement Sale
notes.notes:
[h3]What the heck is this?[/h3]
We know this game is wildly different than Influent so apologies for bugging you if there's absolutely zero interest but we still hope you might like it! It's family-friendly and a love-letter to the couch-party style games of yesteryear. If that floats your boat, check out the Release Date Announcement Trailer below!

[previewyoutube=jcOYG4Hqo_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Word on the Street[/h3]
If that trailer got you hyped to play it, [i]please[/i] do us a solid and tell at least one other person about it. We don't really believe in advertising because we hate ads. Honestly we have no idea how things gain momentum in the collective subconscious but we're guessing it has something to do with word of mouth. If that trailer alone didn't blow your mind, then maybe the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jcOYG4Hqo_Q]Arcade Edition Reveal Trailer[/url] will! Here's a list of [url=https://threeflip.com/locations/]arcade locations[/url].

[h3]Wish Upon a Blob[/h3]
Here's a link to the Steam Store Page for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/446510/Armed_and_Gelatinous_Couch_Edition/]Armed and Gelatinous: Couch Edition[/url] in case you're feeling extra jiggly after watching the trailer. Wishlist it to get updates when it releases on May 2nd, 2024!

[h3]Sale Time![/h3]
To celebrate our big release date announcement, we're discounting Influent for the next two weeks! For those who don't already know, Influent has been consolidated into one Definitive Edition, meaning all 23 languages are now included. Get it while it's hot!

[h3]What's Next?[/h3]
After the release of Armed and Gelatinous: Couch Edition (and a much-needed vacay), I will be able to address some of the feature requests for Influent such as First Person View mode among other things. Excited to be able to re-engage with the community. Thank you all for your patience!

<3 Rob @ Three Flip Studios

notes.title: Influent Vanilla Edition Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Sayonara Storyline[/h1]

That's right folks! Influent's story is finally dead! Let's face it, it was garbage to begin with. I don't know who came up with all that nonsense but it definitely wasn't me. Okay maybe it was me but I promise it was going somewhere until in 2013 when the くそ hit the fan and development screeched to a halt.

What happened you might ask? There's a great quote by John Lennon about how life is what happens to you while you're busy making other plans. So yeah, it never got finished and I'm sorry to anyone who liked it but it's gone now. Maybe I'll rewrite it someday, who knows!

[h1]Adios Chat Events[/h1]

I spent months developing a chat system so the characters could talk to each other in-game like an RPG kinda thing but it turned out to be a lot of slow-paced clutter and people have complained heaps so that's almost completely gone now! I'm sorry I ever programmed it into existence. That's just me apologizing to myself for wasting months of time. It's cool, everything's fine. I'm not crying. Why would I be crying?

[h1]Ciao Tutorial[/h1]

Yeah I guess it might have helped a few people and I'm sure it might leave some in the dark without it but ultimately, Influent is a pretty straightforward experience with a whole world wide web out there where other players can answer questions. That's you right? I'm looking at you! Either way, I'm happy to field questions on the discord and on the Steam forums if anyone ever gets lost or confused. The game just dumps you right into it now. Sink or swim! I hope you swim.

Also I'll probably bring back the FPS mode someday soon, I know you want it back.

<3 Rob @ Three Flip Studios

PS - The game is also a lot cheaper now! Tell your friends!

notes.title: Thanksgiving Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/5794725/8d29356a724ac2773e7a7c8532f73f84e4d6e452.png[/img]

[url=http://playinfluent.com/2017/11/21/thanksgiving-update-sale/]SEE THE OFFICIAL BLOG POST HERE[/url]

[h1]Thankfully Not Forgotten[/h1]

First off, a big thank you to everyone on the Influent forums for your fantastic suggestions and feedback. Lots of great ideas bouncing around on there.

In response to a few of the most highly requested features made by the community, a special Thanksgiving Update has been released...

[h1]The Spread[/h1]

Most notably, there is a new way to play! By selecting Limitless Raid and then either Time Attack or Fly By, the game will feed you the entire vocab list you've collected. Furthermore, Limitless mode has been designed with spaced repetition in mind so you'll be fed new and not-yet-mastered words first!

See the changelog below for  more details.

[h1]Thanksgiving Sale[/h1]

Speaking of giving thanks, from now until Nov 28th, Influent's base game will be featured at 75% off (includes one language of your choice). As for the DLC, additional Language Pack will be featured at 50% off!

Thanks again everyone. More updates to come!

Bon Appétit!


[h1]Changelog:[/h1]
[list]
[*] New [b]Limitless Raid[/b] Mode to Time Attack & Fly By (all words at once)
[*] Implemented Leitner SRS on Limitless Raid (newest and forgotten words are given first)
[*] Added Gold Lining to bottom bar for words that have already been collected
[*] Improved Cloud Save System (hopefully not broken anymore!)
[*] Added Mandarin Chinese UI (Simplified)
[*] Added Mandarin Chinese UI (Traditional)
[*] Improved performance and collisions
[*] Rebuilt in-game lighting
[*] Minor UI bug fixes
[/list]
